title: Report-Age Part of the Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge
content:
Report-age part — Appraisal Order update visit charge

**Rule.** The report-age part of the update visit charge reads the report's age at the scheduled closing date: an age of 211 days or more adds 150 dollars, an age of 151 to 210 days adds 75 dollars, and a younger report adds nothing. The report's age is the number of calendar days from the inspection date on the Appraisal Order to the closing date currently scheduled on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports. The report-age part is added into the standard update charge.

| Report age at the scheduled closing date | Adds (USD) |
|---|---|
| 211 days or more | 150.00 |
| 151 to 210 days | 75.00 |
| 150 days or fewer | 0.00 |

**Edges of each band (hypothetical ages).** 150 days adds nothing; 151 days adds 75.00; 210 days adds 75.00; 211 days adds 150.00.

**Basis Q&A.**
- *Which closing date is used?* The closing date currently scheduled on the Mortgage Loan File at the time the charge is worked out; when that date moves, the age moves with it.
- *Which inspection date?* The date the appraiser inspected the property, or completed the desktop analysis, as recorded on the Appraisal Order.
